experience.title: Senior Data Analyst
bullets: Responsible for the delivery time model for checkout. Late deliveries went down 18% in two quarters.
Worked on A/B tests on the booking flow with the product team, 14 tests, 5 shipped.
Made a dashboard to replace 9 weekly spreadsheet reports for 60+ city managers.

experience.title: Data Analyst
bullets: Looked at the booking funnel and found the three steps where 40% of people dropped off.
Did the monthly revenue report using SQL and Python, from 3 days to 4 hours.

body.job_text: We're hiring a product analyst to work with our payments product team. You'll define the metrics for new features, design and read A/B tests, and build dashboards in Looker on BigQuery. Strong SQL and Python, experience with experimentation and statistics, and the ability to explain results to product managers and engineers. 3-5 years of experience.
